$comment: The globe's top level (the owner, 6 October 2026): one bubble per continent, which opens into one node per country. A Destination's continent is read from its own record: the first entry whose `regions` names the record's `region`, else the first whose `scopes` names its `scope`. A vocabulary of words the records already use, so a new Destination needs no code. src/lib/continents.mjs reads it.
